comments.text: Watching Amish country feels like discovering someone found the “unsubscribe” button for modern life centuries ago. No endless notifications, no traffic apps, and somehow the day still gets finished. Meanwhile I panic when my phone battery reaches 10 percent. It really makes you wonder: who is actually living the simpler life?
